item.title: [webrtc-stats, webrtc] Some RTC pages reference missing BCD identifiers
item.content:encoded:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/RTCIceCandidatePairStats/availableIncomingBitrate etc

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

No response

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

There are 8 pages that point to BCD data removed 3 years ago in mdn/browser-compat-data#18910, with a warning like this:

No compatibility data found for api.RTCStatsReport.type_candidate-pair.availableIncomingBitrate.

What did you expect to see?

Probably the pages shouldn't exist.
